project_type: Go monolith with dual-binary architecture (engine gateway + worker). Phase 3 adds gateway dispatcher to route requests to workers.
build_system: go build, no custom Makefile. CGO_ENABLED=1 required for zen-go JDM library.
test_framework: go test with stdlib testing package. Integration tests in *_integration_test.go files.
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'go build ./cmd/engine' to verify compilation. 2. Run 'go test ./internal/gateway/...' for new gateway tests. 3. Run 'go vet ./...' for static analysis. 4. Verify no circular imports with 'go build ./...'
environment_constraints: k8s.io/client-go not yet in go.mod - must be added. sony/gobreaker/v2 already present for circuit breaker pattern (see internal/connect/resilience.go).
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns in internal/connect for resilience (gobreaker). Follow internal/worker/handler.go pattern for HTTP handlers. Use stdlib net/http, no chi/gin. Use log/slog for logging. Error classification follows internal/config/errors.go pattern.
key_patterns: Circuit breaker: sony/gobreaker/v2 with configurable thresholds (internal/connect/resilience.go)
Worker types: ExecuteRequest/ExecuteResponse in internal/worker/types.go - REUSE for gateway
HTTP handler pattern: stdlib net/http with manual mux registration (internal/worker/handler.go)
Store methods: internal/config/pgstore_worker.go for WorkerStore interface
directory_structure: engine/cmd/{engine,worker} - binaries. engine/internal/{config,connect,decision,flow,httpapi,observ,scheduler,webhook,worker} - packages. Phase 3 adds engine/internal/gateway/.
